controls: Freeze build inputs; hash actual wheel/kit and compare runtime/content members to frozen bytes, including newest coverage/profile changes. A test-built wheel does not verify another artifact. Reject drift.
Actual artifact outside checkout, offline venv/import pins; real console/generated MCP cannot fall back to checkout. Vendor CLIs absent; fake codex is not native execution.

Old kit -> candidate -> repeat -> uninstall in ONE disposable home/store. Preserve pinned config/rules/profile/private knowledge/memory/operational records/reachable backups. Profile rollback is not whole-install atomicity.

Knowledge manifest/archive/files match hashes. User-edit conflicts never overwrite; repeat idempotent. Traversal/symlink/corrupt bundle refuses before publication; explicit store beats ambient environment.
Query published knowledge through fresh generated MCP and retained warm server: current hits/citations, explicit roots fixed, disjoint miss empty. Directory presence is insufficient.
Keep commands/exits, interpreter/import pins, JUnit counts and all skip/xfail/warning reasons. Skipped capability NOT_VERIFIED; temporary-home smoke proves no native Windows/laptop/client loading.
limit: Full check.sh is source tests+scan+demo, not original16case/v2 quality-token qualification, deployment or release.
